title: Causal Representation Learning from Multimodal Clinical Records under Non-Random Modality Missingness
abstract: arXiv:2509.17228v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Clinical notes contain rich patient information, such as diagnoses or medications, making them valuable for patient representation learning. Recent advances in large language models have further improved the ability to extract meaningful representations from clinical texts. However, clinical notes are often missing. For example, in our MIMIC-IV cohort, 35.15% of patients have no eligible discharge summaries. In such cases, representations can be learned from other modalities such as structured data, chest X-rays, or radiology reports. Yet the availability of these modalities is influenced by clinical decision-making and varies across patients, potentially producing modality missing-not-at-random (MMNAR) patterns. translated_title: 非随机模态缺失下从多模态临床记录中进行的因果表征学习
translated_abstract: 临床笔记包含丰富的患者信息，例如诊断或用药信息，使其在患者表征学习中具有重要价值。大型语言模型的最新进展进一步提升了从临床文本中提取有意义表征的能力。然而，临床笔记经常缺失。例如，在我们的MIMIC-IV队列中，35.15%的患者没有符合条件的出院小结。在这种情况下，可以从其他模态（如结构化数据、胸部X光片或放射学报告）学习表征。然而，这些模态的可用性受到临床决策的影响，并且在患者之间存在差异，可能产生模态非随机缺失模式。我们提出了一种因果表征学习框架，该框架利用多模态临床记录中的观测数据和信息性缺失。它包括：(1) 一个MMNAR感知的模态融合组件...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种因果表征学习框架，通过感知模态非随机缺失模式，融合多模态临床记录中的观测数据与信息性缺失，从而实现更可靠的患者表征学习。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a causal representation learning framework that leverages observed data and informative missingness in multimodal clinical records through an MMNAR-aware modality fusion component, enabling more reliable patient representation learning under non-random modality missingness.
